# Purpose

This memo summarizes the proposed timeline for the Q3 budget review and
requests sign-off on the schedule below before circulating it to
department heads.

No table of contents, list of figures/tables, or abbreviations list is
included -- unlike `examples/demo-report`, a memo's "loose structure"
deliberately skips all of that (see the `examples/memo-example/README.md`
and `_extensions/quartifyr/README.md`'s "Memo cover page" section for
why none of that requires any quartifyr code changes to omit).

# Proposed Schedule

- Department budget submissions due August 21
- Finance Committee review August 24-28
- Consolidated review meeting September 2
- Final sign-off September 9

# Next Steps

Please review the schedule above and reply with any conflicts by
